program.name: Kickboxing Volume
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Long kickboxing sessions: kicks and knees, then combinations, with conditioning after.
program.about: Kickboxing with time for every weapon. One day is a long run of kick and knee bouts, then a bodyweight circuit; the other is bouts of punch-and-kick combinations, then Tabatas. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Kick & knee bouts & circuit / combo bouts & Tabatas
